newsitem.title: UK: European jet fuel steady, to touch easier.
newsitem.headline: European jet fuel steady, to touch easier.

text.p: European jet fuel was essentially steady with narrowly easier futures only impacting barges.
May IPE gas oil last traded 50 cents down at $162.25.

Traders said barge premiums were unchanged at May IPE +$18 fob ARA, with one deal concluded at this level. Cargo premiums were a touch firmer with a bid of May IPE +$23 cif NWE finding little offer interest lower than May IPE +$24.
"The market is pretty much stuffed full with jet in storage and sellers are holding out for $24," said one trader who said the market was fundementally oversupplied.
A May swap was traded at $24.50.
In the Mediterranean EU grade was pegged unchanged at fob high quotes +$8 with Libyan $2-3 lower.
